dialogues.speaker: Healthy Meal Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Congratulations to our weight-watching friends! We are now unveiling our latest revolutionary recipe — the Fat Fighter's Nutri-Meal!"

dialogues.speaker: Healthy Meal Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Just two servings provide enough nutrients for a full day, while each meal can be stored for up to three months. Just boil it in hot water and then tuck in! Get yours now!"

dialogues.speaker: Superficial Handwriting
dialogues.text: "I can lose weight just by eating? Brilliant! I'll take 100 servings!"

dialogues.speaker: Superficial Handwriting
dialogues.text: "I ate all 100 servings and not only did I not lose weight — I actually GAINED weight! I'm going to the chief! This is just a scam to trick us outsiders out of their money!"

dialogues.speaker: Healthy Meal Advertisement
dialogues.text: "I only sold those meals to you 10 days ago, which means you must have eaten 10 a day! I clearly said two servings provide enough nutrients for a full day. It's a wonder you're not wider than a Tatankasaurus!"
